ColonyCouncil.DilemmaDef.label: a night under the falling stars

texts.li: The stars have been falling over the region for nights now, and half the colony has been sneaking out to look. {A_nameDef} asks the council to stop pretending otherwise: one night, everyone who wants to out under the open sky together, with a fire and something warm, to watch them while they last.\n\nSome say the falling stars are a sign. {A_nameDef} says it doesn't much matter of what. It would be a short night's sleep before a working day.

[lowtech] The old people say a sky full of falling stars is something you tell your grandchildren about, and {A_nameDef} means to have something to tell. {A_nameDef} asks the council for one night with everyone out on the open ground, a fire lit, watching the stars come down.\n\nThe colony would be tired the next day, and nobody would be sorry.

[!lowtech] {FACTION} at {PLACE} have their readers out with instruments every night, and the colony has been watching the same sky from its doorways. {A_nameDef} asks the council for one night out together, a fire on the open ground and everyone who wants to lying back and counting.\n\nIt would cost a little sleep.

li.label: A night under the stars for all who want it
li.outcome: Tonight, everyone who wants to will go out to the open ground after supper, light a fire, and watch the stars fall until the cold sends them in.

li.label: the night of the falling stars
The work starts early tomorrow
li.outcome: The colony goes to bed at the usual time. {A_nameDef} thinks it is missing something it will not see again.
